task: purchase in selected commodity within next 28 dataset days
category_rule: most distinct household buyers in GROCERY before day 365; alphabetical tie break
eligibility: at least one positive-quantity transaction within prior 84 days
limitations: Dataset days are relative indices, not known calendar dates.
Nonpurchase means no qualifying record at the observed retailer, not no purchase anywhere.
Demographic codes are not decoded into age or income.
One category and one retailer cannot establish general population fidelity.
